search_scope: Targeted primary articles and open repositories for 45 min alternating effort, repeated cycling sprints, match simulation, comparable pre/post MVC or power, tracking, and reaction with accuracy. Search was targeted and non-systematic.

mclaughlin.admission: 45 min of a 60 min continuous protocol; workbook reference channel is rectal; no alternating efforts or separate post-45 functional battery

jutlah.license: Public read; redistribution permission not established
jutlah.admission: Matched cycling efforts within 168, 222 or 276 s; external work reported for efforts; condition and visit order tied (24, 18, 12 s)

norbury.admission: Individual paired MVC in N at nominal delays after four sets; timing of each individual test unavailable

stroop.admission: Within-participant change against rest in 20 min cycling study; individual stimulus timestamps and exact post delay absent in file

velocity.admission: Leg press terminal relative velocity loss in 23 participants; absolute velocity, duration, post and movement errors not in CSV

candidates.name: Almquist et al. prolonged cycling with repeated sprints
candidates.status: File inspected. Two aggregate tables of pre-sprint VO2, power and gross efficiency; no participant-level power/time or pre/post battery. Protocol 3 h with hourly sprint sets.

candidates.name: Almquist et al. work-matched continuous/intermittent crossover
candidates.status: Four-hour crossover in 12 elite cyclists. Primary article describes work matching; no session-level work files obtained. Aggregate result on stability of sprint performance has no equivalent 2700 s battery.

candidates.name: Marshall et al. SAFT90
candidates.status: Two matched 45 min halves with repeated sprint times and halftime MVT; explicit restriction to published means and standard deviations. Torque loss at halftime 7.6% ± 9.4% SD. No synchronized mechanical work or participant series; date of each assessment relative to last effort cannot be reconstructed.

candidates.name: Goodall et al. simulated match 120 min
candidates.status: 10 participants; halftime MVC change -11% ± 6% SD; published repeated sessions support a task-specific reliability scale. No joint individual file retrieved; halftime battery lacks the full CPE45 vector.

candidates.name: Massamba et al. simulated match
candidates.status: 11 participants; 2×45 min with additional neuromuscular tests between 15-min blocks. Open thesis describes protocol; no participant-linked power/force/displacement and control files retrieved.

candidates.name: Vigh-Larsen et al. intermittent cycling
candidates.status: 3 Hz power described; primary data availability statement requires reasonable request.

candidates.name: du Plessis et al. 2/4 min CWR
candidates.status: Metadata HTTP 200; individual downloads for main data 1490455, README 1490487, and pre/post 1490458 failed (403 on public stream; 401 on API file download). Published power loss is 32% vs 47%; individual timing and paired estimates unavailable for replay.

candidates.name: SkillCorner and SoccerMon field tracking
candidates.status: Tracking can describe movement; unrestricted match demands make matched fatigue contrasts invalid. No shared objective work and functional pre/post battery documented.

candidates.name: Ogoh et al. prolonged cycling and Stroop
candidates.status: 0, 10, 20 and 50 min during continuous cycling with respiratory-gas manipulation. Protocol-level comparator for cognitive response only; no joint 45 min interval or movement-error dataset inspected.
